description: Release-control surface (ops/devops-foundation.md §2.1). Type 1: changing this schema is a contract change. Non-contract metadata keys (e.g. _comment, changed_by) are permitted alongside the contractual ones.

canary_services.description: Non-empty = candidate policy applies only to these services. REJECTED by the loader until the R-15 dual-policy canary mechanism exists (fail-closed).

canary_severity_bands.description: Non-empty = candidate policy applies only to these inbound severity bands. REJECTED by the loader until the R-15 dual-policy canary mechanism exists (fail-closed).

global_kill_switch.description: ON = the gate returns passthrough for every alert (instant flag-off). Turning OFF requires two named humans.

shadow_mode.description: ON = log the would-be disposition, always return passthrough. Mirrors SENTINEL_SHADOW.

suppress_enabled.description: OFF = suppress dispositions become passthrough (never silently queued).

version.description: Contract version. The loader and flagctl both require 1.

title: flags.json — Sentinel feature-flag contract
